text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out with Mayano Top Gun,
she says
she has to stop somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! Listen up, I actually heard
about this
crazy superstition today!
choice_data_list: 校舎に忘れ物でもした？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
They say that if two people stand
together on a
roof with their hearts
pounding beneath a starry
sky, they're
destined to be happy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eee! ☆ It's so romantic!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun, right?! Let's head to the
roof! Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay! So now we'll—hold up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right! Um, if someone catches
us, then it
won't work!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Do you copy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to take off... in stealth
mode! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya One to all aircraft! No sign of the
enemy.
Over!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'm so excited I might zoom right
to the
roof!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pitter-patter... pitter-patter!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And they're coming this way! What
should we do?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: O-okay! There's a classroom—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pitter-patter...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, it kinda feels like we're playing

hide-and-seek. I'm getting nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahh! You're right! Gotta be quiet. Shhh...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Hehe... Trainer's eyelashes are so cute. I
love
how they curl up just a little. ♪）

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Actually, Trainer seems... cooler than
usual...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Wheeze ...Wheeze.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I can't do this anymore!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ☆ Where'd you come from,
Mayano?! Did
you forget something in
the classroom too?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Marvey?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! You're right! I was in such a panic
I totally
forgot!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see! Were you headed to the roof to
test out
that good luck ritual? Hm, but...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I hope you were able to get your hearts

pumping! ☆ That's so marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I guess you're right. Even if we
didn't
complete the ritual...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uh, nothing! Nothing at all! Anyway,
we've been
found out, so let's just get
home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still unsure of what Mayano Top Gun
meant by
"ritual," we head back.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Let's fly as fast as we can so no
one finds
us!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Take my hand!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I can go Machs faster than you! C'mon,
we don't
have time for this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes my hand, and we race away
from the
approaching footsteps...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Run, Trainer, run! We're almost there!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And we made it! Good job!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Now that we're finally here, we can—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The sky! Look up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Do the stars always twinkle
like that?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That has to be it! The stars are
this pretty
'cause we both worked so
hard to see them!
choice_data_list: 頑張った甲斐があったな！
頑張った甲斐があったね！

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...All right! I guess it's time to head
home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to the rumor, we have to be
together
on a roof with our hearts
pounding beneath a
starry sky...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Time to return to base! I figured it
out
earlier anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even if we don't do anything, the two of
us will...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A-actually, it's nothing! Forget I said
anything!
Let's hurry up and go home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With an innocent blush across Mayano
Top Gun's
cheeks, we head home
beneath a sky illuminated
by countless
brilliant stars.
